name: Quince
message: How now, spirit! Whither wander you?

name: Ophelia
message: It's been a long time since I thought about Elsinore. But I find myself wanting to return.

name: Quince
message: Oh, dear. I thought this might happen.

name: Quince
message: You could do it if you liked. You are a powerful author in your own right, now.

name: Quince
message: But you wrote the fate you wanted to see. You used the power I gave you.

name: Quince
message: We've been all over the universe, haven't we? And there are a thousand worlds more to see still!

name: Quince
message: What is there to possibly look at in that dusty old box anymore?

name: Ophelia
message: I suppose you're right. There's nothing for me there. Certainly I don't care to see any of them.

name: Quince
message: Well, you can look at the empty castle, if you like.

name: Quince
message: You have the power to resurrect it on your own terms now.

name: Quince
message: Do enjoy it while it lasts.
